verdict.rationale: Docs show stakeholders can log in to view their own holdings ('My Equity' view, doc-29) and that cap tables/documents are automatically shared via a data room and smart-linking (docs-7,8,9), which reduces ad-hoc requests to founders. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated investor-update/reporting feature (e.g., automated investor newsletters or update pushes) distinct from the general data room and stakeholder equity view. missing for 10: explicit investor-portal branding/documentation, structured update/notification workflow for investors, independent confirmation of investor usage.
